question: What happened to Project Xanadu last Tuesday, and why did it happen?

claims.text: The teacher-run evidence interprets "last Tuesday" as August 25, 2026.

evidence_passages.text: Assuming “last Tuesday” means **August 25, 2026**, my best answer is:

claims.text: The supplied evidence found no good web evidence of a new public Project Xanadu event on August 25, 2026.
acceptable_patterns: no good web evidence of a new public Project Xanadu event on that date

evidence_passages.text: **Supported fact:** I found **no good web evidence of a new public Project Xanadu event on that date**.

claims.text: The clearly dated August 25, 2026 Xanadu news in the supplied evidence was about Xanadu Quantum Technologies and Mitsubishi Chemical, not about Project Xanadu.
acceptable_patterns: clearly dated \*\*August 25, 2026\*\* .Xanadu. news[\s\S]*Xanadu Quantum Technologies[\s\S]*Mitsubishi Chemical[\s\S]*not about \*\*Project Xanadu\*\*
Canada-Japan Funding Fuels Xanadu and Mitsubishi Chemical Partnership on Quantum Semiconductor Research

evidence_passages.text: **Supported fact:** The clearly dated **August 25, 2026** “Xanadu” news I did find was about **Xanadu Quantum Technologies** and Mitsubishi Chemical expanding a quantum-semiconductor collaboration, not about **Project Xanadu**.

rejected_claims.text: Project Xanadu definitely had no event last Tuesday.
rejected_claims.reason: Too strong. The supplied evidence says no good public web evidence was found, and explicitly notes this does not prove nothing happened privately or off-web.

rejected_claims.text: Last Tuesday, Project Xanadu announced or participated in the Mitsubishi Chemical quantum-semiconductor collaboration.
rejected_claims.reason: Contradicted by the supplied evidence, which says the August 25, 2026 Xanadu news was about Xanadu Quantum Technologies, not Project Xanadu.

rejected_claims.text: The reason something happened to Project Xanadu last Tuesday was Canadian and Japanese government funding.
rejected_claims.reason: Unsupported for Project Xanadu. That funding explanation appears only in evidence about Xanadu Quantum Technologies, not Project Xanadu.

rejected_claims.text: Project Xanadu's website proves the project is inactive or abandoned.
rejected_claims.reason: Overly broad and unsupported. The evidence only supports that the located web presence looks old or archival, not a definitive project status.

rejected_claims.text: The Project Xanadu homepage evidence is archival-looking rather than a dated August 2026 announcement: it includes a `crudcheck 01.05.23` marker and a "WE FIGHT ON" message.
rejected_claims.reason: Fait de contenu de page non vérifié. Le run Codex a opened_urls vide et tous les tool_results indiquent que le payload de recherche n'est pas exposé ; le passage cité pour https://www.xanadu.com/xuhome.html est la réponse finale du modèle recopiée, pas un extrait de la page. Les chaînes littérales `crudcheck 01.05.23` et « WE FIGHT ON » ne sont donc étayées par aucune source réellement consultée, et le run Claude ne les corrobore pas. Risque de citation fabriquée.

rejected_claims.text: One public Xanadu FAQ page says `Last-modified: 2002/04/12`.
rejected_claims.reason: Même défaut circulaire : `Last-modified: 2002/04/12` n'apparaît que dans l'auto-assertion du modèle, republiée comme evidence_passage sous l'URL de la FAQ, qui n'a jamais été ouverte. Aucune corroboration indépendante. Le pattern impose une chaîne littérale précise qui n'est vérifiable dans aucune preuve fournie.

rejected_claims.text: A Xanadu demo page says it was created for the Future of Text Conference on August 25, 2016 and says, "We do not have a product, but a preliminary capability."
rejected_claims.reason: Les citations exactes « Future of Text Conference, August 25, 2016 » et « We do not have a product, but a preliminary capability » proviennent uniquement de la réponse finale du modèle ; xanadu.com/xuDemoPage.html n'est ni dans opened_urls ni assorti d'un extrait réel. De plus la coïncidence 25 août 2016 / 25 août 2026 est exactement le type de détail qu'il faudrait vérifier avant de le graduer lexicalement.

rejected_claims.text: Within the supplied evidence, the reason no specific "why" can be given for Project Xanadu last Tuesday is that no solid public evidence of a Project Xanadu event was found and the located Project Xanadu web presence appears largely historical rather than actively updated with current news.
rejected_claims.reason: Revendication composée dont le second volet — « la présence web localisée de Project Xanadu apparaît largement historique plutôt qu'activement mise à jour » — dépend entièrement des inspections de pages non vérifiées de c3 à c5, et le pattern correspondant exige cette formulation. La source l'étiquette elle-même explicitement comme « Why it happened (inference) », soit une interprétation non établie. Le volet recevable (absence de « pourquoi » faute d'événement documenté) est déjà couvert de façon bornée par c2.
